summary: Verified Phase 2 UX polish end-to-end via guest-mode Playwright flow: milestone tracker, transformation cards on Steps 1/2/3, renamed OutputCard affordances (Copy / Challenge this / Refine with AI-when-present), empty-state teaching + REFINE/CONTINUE/START labels on ProjectOverview, Step 5 second-project nudge post-lock, and regression on paste-anything Dashboard flow. All 5 features + regression PASS.

verified_features.detail: data-testid='milestone-tracker' + 'milestone-tracker-label' render on Project Flow header. Label text = 'YOUR JOURNEY'. Done steps show milestone verbs: step1='Project understood', step2='Signals compressed', step3='Decision made', step4='Artifacts drafted', step5='Locked & signed'. Todo steps still show task labels ('Situation framing', 'Context compression', etc.). Done nodes get 'is-done' state and green check icon.

data-testid='step1-transformation' renders below OutputCard after framing. Shows '{ transformation }' label, word count (118 words in), tensions named (5), clarity score (35), and italic note 'You pasted a mess. Bracket returned a reframed problem, a clarity read of 35/100, and 5 tensions worth watching.'
data-testid='step2-transformation' renders with key signals (6), noise stripped (4), hidden assumptions (6) counts.
data-testid='step3-transformation' renders with recommendation (1), alternatives (2), risks (4), and note including confidence: 'Called with 85% confidence — not a menu, a stance.'

Actions bar shows 'Copy' and 'Challenge this' (onRegenerate button with data-testid step1-framing-output-regenerate). 'Refine with AI' (onEdit) button not rendered on Step 1 because onEdit prop is not passed — consistent with review spec 'if onEdit present'. Zero 'Redo' or literal 'Edit' labels anywhere in the page. Progressive summary reveal works before actions surface.

Fresh project with only step 1 done shows overview-empty-teaching-2/-3/-4/-5 blurbs. Step 1 (done) does not render teaching. Blurbs match spec ('We\'ll strip your paste...', 'We\'ll pick a side (not a menu)...', etc.). Overview label reads '{ your journey · five milestones }'.
Done step buttons say 'REFINE' (verified on all 5 done steps of locked project). Current step says 'CONTINUE'. Not-started steps say 'START'. No 'EDIT' label remains.

Nudge is absent before lock. After POST /projects/{id}/lock, data-testid='step5-second-project-nudge' appears with '{ next client · ready? }' label, headline 'Ready for your next client?', and CTA 'Start a new project' → step5-new-project-btn with href='/app'.

Guest login → click quickstart tile (dashboard-quickstart-saas-landing) populates 118-word paste → click 'Structure this brief' → auto-navigates to /project/{id}/flow → sessionStorage-hydrated paste auto-submits Step 1 → step1-framing-output renders reframed problem, tensions and clarity score. End-to-end paste flow stable.

critical_code_review_comments: ProjectFlow.jsx is now 2257 lines — well over the 700-line guideline. Consider splitting Step1-5 + OutputCard/TransformationCard/StepProgress into separate modules for maintainability.

OutputCard component in Step 1 does not pass onEdit prop, so 'Refine with AI' button never surfaces on the primary framing card. If the intent is to expose refine-with-AI everywhere, wire it in (Steps 2 & 3 also lack onEdit). If intentional (only Copy + Challenge this on framing/decision), consider dropping onEdit prop entirely from OutputCard to keep the API honest.
test_credentials: Guest mode via login-guest-btn (POST /api/auth/guest) — sufficient for all UX flows tested.
seed_data_creation: Created 2 guest projects via UI quickstart flow (project_ids b03540a7-... fully locked, 3b01344c-... only step1 done). Both auto-cleaned as guest data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 2 UX polish is stable. All new data-testids present: milestone-tracker, milestone-tracker-label, step{1-3}-transformation, step{1-3}-transformation-<key> children, step5-second-project-nudge, step5-new-project-btn, overview-empty-teaching-{1-5}. Guest flow via login-guest-btn works. Backend AI calls (Claude Sonnet 4.5) took ~15-30s per step during testing — always sleep 90s max when waiting on step outputs.
